zh.title: 新北空軍三重一村將舉辦夏日煙火活動 推廣眷村與軍事文化
zh.summary: 新北市三重的「空軍三重一村」將於8月15日舉辦「夏日煙火烤肉趴」活動，並於今日起正式開放限量50組的網路報名。該活動結合了眷村文化體驗、街頭藝人現場表演，以及觀賞大稻埕煙火等多元元素，期望透過軟性的公眾參與拉近民眾與歷史的距離。 空軍三重一村為臺灣北部地區保存最為完整的防砲眷村，過去主要提供給負責首都及台北松山機場（TSA）周邊防空任務的空軍高射砲兵軍眷居住。
body: 新北市三重的「空軍三重一村」將於8月15日舉辦「夏日煙火烤肉趴」活動，並於今日起正式開放限量50組的網路報名。該活動結合了眷村文化體驗、街頭藝人現場表演，以及觀賞大稻埕煙火等多元元素，期望透過軟性的公眾參與拉近民眾與歷史的距離。   空軍三重一村為臺灣北部地區保存最為完整的防砲眷村，過去主要提供給負責首都及台北松山機場（TSA）周邊防空任務的空軍高射砲兵軍眷居住。雖然此次活動並非直接涉及飛航安全或近期的空軍戰備演練，但該地點的活化利用，具體反映了空軍與地方社區在文化連結上的持續努力。透過此類群眾活動，不僅有助於軍事文化的推廣，也讓珍貴的眷村建築與歷史記憶得以在現代都會中被妥善保存與傳承。 「夏日煙火烤肉趴」活動資訊： 活動時間：2026/8/15（六）18:00－21:00 地點：空軍三重一村（新北市三重區正義南路86巷） 名額：限量50組（額滿即截止） 活動亮點：眷村烤肉、街頭藝人表演、抽獎活動、遠眺大稻埕煙火 報名方式：7/29（三）19:00開放報名，詳情請至「空軍三重一村」官方粉絲專頁查詢

en.title: New Taipei's Air Force Sanchong Village No. 1 to Hold Summer Fireworks Event to Promote Military Dependents' Village and Military Culture
en.summary: "Air Force Sanchong Village No. 1" in Sanchong, New Taipei City, will host a "Summer Fireworks BBQ Party" event on August 15, with online registration officially opening today for a limited 50 groups. Combining military dependents' village cultural experiences, live street performer shows, and viewing of the Dadaocheng fireworks, the event aims to bridge the distance between the public and history through soft public engagement. Air Force Sanchong Village No. 1 is northern Taiwan's most completely preserved anti-aircraft artillery military dependents' village, historically housing families of Air Force anti-aircraft artillery personnel responsible for air defense missions surrounding the capital and Taipei Songshan Airport (TSA).
body: "Air Force Sanchong Village No. 1" in Sanchong, New Taipei City, will hold a "Summer Fireworks BBQ Party" event on August 15, with online registration officially opening today for a limited 50 groups. The event integrates diverse elements including military dependents' village cultural experiences, live street performer entertainment, and distant views of the Dadaocheng fireworks, hoping to bring the public closer to history through soft public engagement. Air Force Sanchong Village No. 1 is the most intact anti-aircraft artillery military dependents' village preserved in northern Taiwan, which historically served as quarters for military dependents of Air Force anti-aircraft artillery units tasked with air defense missions around the capital and Taipei Songshan Airport (TSA). Although this event does not directly involve aviation safety or recent Air Force combat readiness drills, the revitalization and reuse of this site specifically reflects the ongoing efforts toward cultural connections between the Air Force and the local community. Through such public events, it not only helps promote military culture but also allows precious military dependents' village architecture and historical memories to be properly preserved and passed down in a modern metropolis. "Summer Fireworks BBQ Party" event information: Event time: August 15, 2026 (Sat) 18:00–21:00 Location: Air Force Sanchong Village No. 1 (Lane 86, Zhengyi South Road, Sanchong District, New Taipei City) Capacity: Limited to 50 groups (closes when full) Event highlights: Military dependents' village BBQ, street artist performances, lucky draw, distant view of Dadaocheng fireworks Registration method: Registration opens at 19:00 on July 29 (Wed); for details, please visit the official "Air Force Sanchong Village No. 1" Facebook fan page.
